headline: City bus slams into 32 vehicles near Seoul, injuring 57 during morning rush hour
headline_es: Un autobús urbano choca contra 32 vehículos cerca de Seúl y deja 57 heridos en hora punta
caption_en: A city bus struck 32 vehicles, including four buses, a truck and 27 cars, some of them waiting at a traffic light, in the Bundang district of Seongnam, south of Seoul, at about 7:34 a.m. on Wednesday. It came to a stop against a median barrier. Nine people were seriously injured and 48 suffered minor injuries; no deaths were reported.
caption_es: Un autobús urbano chocó contra 32 vehículos, entre ellos cuatro autobuses, un camión y 27 coches, algunos detenidos en un semáforo, en el distrito de Bundang, en Seongnam, al sur de Seúl, hacia las 7:34 del miércoles. Se detuvo contra una barrera de la mediana. Nueve personas resultaron heridas de gravedad y 48 con lesiones leves; no se informó de fallecidos.
summary_es: El choque ocurrió en Bundang, en Seongnam, durante la hora punta matinal. Nueve heridos graves y 48 leves; no se reportaron muertos.
summary_en: The crash happened in Bundang, Seongnam, during the morning commute. Nine people were seriously hurt and 48 slightly; no deaths reported.
